pois.label: 连续电熔窑(黑玻璃的心脏)
pois.label_en: Continuous electric melter (heart of the black line)
pois.detail: 剖开的电熔池:三支钼电极直插熔池,焦耳热在玻璃液内部产生——没有火焰,没有烟气,只有 1450 °C 的橙红液面。这本册要先打碎一个幻觉:玄武岩熔出来的玻璃是黑的。Jezero 玄武岩 FeO 19.2 wt%(与铸造厂/宇宙线量能器同一张 Rocknest 成分表),铁在玻璃里就是墨——所以这座窑供的是纤维、岩棉和铸石三条黑色产线,150 kg/sol,窗户的事归旁边那条小得多的透明线。**注意剖口里三圈色带的厚度比**:灰白的本厂岩棉、米黄的保温砖、褐色的 AZS 熔接触层加起来 0.79 m,而里面的玻璃只有 1.2 × 0.7 m 一浴缸——这台炉子的体积绝大部分不是玻璃,是保温。
pois.detail_en: A cut-open electric melter: three molybdenum electrodes reach straight into the bath, and Joule heat is generated inside the glass itself - no flame, no flue gas, just an orange melt line at 1450 C. This volume opens by breaking an illusion: glass melted from basalt is black. Jezero basalt carries 19.2 wt% FeO (the same Rocknest table used by the foundry and the cosmic-ray calorimeter), and iron in glass is ink. So this furnace feeds the three black product lines - fiber, wool and cast stone, 150 kg/sol - while windows belong to the far smaller clear line next door. **Note the proportions of the three bands in the cut face**: this plant's own rock wool (pale grey), insulating firebrick (cream) and the AZS melt-contact layer (brown) total 0.79 m of wall, while the glass inside is one 1.2 x 0.7 m bathtub. Most of this furnace's volume is not glass - it is insulation.

specs.壁损: 11.75 kW(自下而上实算,撞小型日池窑 8~25 kW 带)
specs.产量: 150 kg/sol(纤维 12 + 岩棉 18 + 铸石 120)
specs.耐火进口: 初装 1.6 t,8 火星年一代 = 0.23 t/会合窗口

specs_en.Bath: 1.2 x 0.7 m, 0.35 m deep - 706 kg held, a 4.7-sol buffer
specs_en.Wall build: AZS 0.15 + insulating firebrick 0.50 + own rock wool 0.135 = 0.79 m
specs_en.Wall loss: 11.75 kW, computed bottom-up, inside the 8-25 kW band for small day tanks
specs_en.Refractory import: 1.6 t first fill, one campaign per 8 Mars years = 0.23 t per synodic window

sim: 【第二轮推翻第一轮(账 8)】第一轮的壁损 1.6 kW 是拍的。按分层墙自下而上实算(约束:自产岩棉只能站 700 °C 以下的冷侧),最优墙厚 0.79 m 下壁损 **11.75 kW**——比熔化玻璃本身(3.24 kW)还大 3.6 倍。全厂均值随之 12.4 → 22.3 kWe,基荷 4.2 → 13.7 kWe。

小炉子的三条反直觉:① **加保温收益有限**——保温砖 0.20→0.50 m 只降 17%,因为墙一厚外表面就跟着长;② **合并壳体比加厚保温管用**:把前炉并进熔窑共用一套墙省 4.2 kW,比保温加厚一倍还多(几何已按此把拉丝工位挪到紧贴窑东侧);③ **固定损耗占 72%**,而固定损耗不认识产品——第一轮给的铸石 1.37 / 岩棉 1.87 / 纤维 5.0 三个比能被抹平成同一个 **3.64 kWh/kg**,是地球的约 2 倍,差额全部来自规模而非工艺。
冻结衬正面否决:用玻璃自己当衬里可以免掉进口耐火砖,但热流由熔体侧对流与过热度定(q = h·ΔT_过热 = 35 kW/m²),湿面 2.17 m² 要白烧 **77 kW**,是全厂的数倍。它在电解铝、冷坩埚那种高热流场合成立,在 6 kg/h 的小炉上不成立——耐火砖必须进口(好在只有 0.23 t/窗口)。
为什么不许停,现在有数:冷启动一次 1263 kWh = **4.4 sol 的保温电**,而衬里只经得起几十次热循环。停机超过 4.4 sol 才在电费上划算,却要拿衬里寿命去换。
sim_en: [Round two overturns round one (ledger 8)] The 1.6 kW wall loss of the first pass was asserted, not computed. Solving the layered wall bottom-up - constrained by the fact that home-made rock wool can only sit on the cold side below 700 C - the optimum 0.79 m wall loses **11.75 kW**, 3.6x more than melting the glass itself (3.24 kW). Plant average moves 12.4 to 22.3 kWe, baseload 4.2 to 13.7 kWe.

Three counterintuitive facts about small furnaces: (1) **more insulation buys little** - going from 0.20 to 0.50 m of firebrick cuts only 17%, because a thicker wall grows its own surface area; (2) **merging enclosures beats thickening them** - folding the forehearth into the melter's wall saves 4.2 kW, more than doubling the insulation would, which is why the drawing station now sits hard against the furnace's east face; (3) **fixed losses are 72% of the load**, and fixed losses do not know which product they are heating - the three separate specific energies quoted in round one (cast 1.37, wool 1.87, fiber 5.0) flatten into a single **3.64 kWh/kg**, about twice Earth's, and every bit of that gap is scale, not process.

Freeze lining, asked and answered: letting the glass freeze into its own lining would remove the refractory import, but the heat flux is set by melt-side convection and superheat (q = h x dT_superheat = 35 kW/m2). Over 2.17 m2 of wetted wall that burns **77 kW**, several times the whole plant. It works for aluminium cells and cold crucibles, not for a 6 kg/h pot - so refractory is imported, which turns out to be only 0.23 t per window.

Why it may never stop, now with a number: one cold start costs 1263 kWh = **4.4 sol of holding power**, and the lining survives only tens of thermal cycles. Idling longer than 4.4 sol pays on electricity but is bought with lining life.
pois.physics: 为什么是电熔:火星没有可燃烧的窑炉燃料,而玻璃液本身是离子导体——通电即自热。为什么玻璃是黑的:Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺ 的吸收带宽得足以吞掉整个可见窗口。而为什么炉子这么厚:热损 ∝ 面积、产量 ∝ 体积,炉子越小,面积/体积比越大,固定损耗就越压不住——**小型化在化学工程里从来不是免费的**,而火星城的需求量注定它只能开小炉子。
pois.physics_en: Why electric melting: Mars offers no furnace fuel, and molten glass is itself an ionic conductor - pass current and it self-heats. Why the glass is black: the Fe2+/Fe3+ absorption bands are broad enough to swallow the visible window. And why the walls are so thick: heat loss scales with area while output scales with volume, so the smaller the furnace the worse its area-to-volume ratio and the harder its fixed losses are to suppress. **Miniaturisation is never free in chemical engineering** - and this city's demand leaves no option but a small furnace.

pois.label: 拉丝工位(0.38 g 的第二次出场)
pois.detail: 前炉东端挂着一块铂铑合金漏板,29 个细孔,1250 °C 的玻璃液靠**自身重力**从孔里漏下,被下方卷绕筒以 12.4 m/s 拉细到 13 µm,过集束轮、上浆,再收卷。第一轮这张卡写着「拉丝与重力无关」——**说对了一半**:衰减确实只看拉速与冷却,但**孔流是重力驱动的**,Q ∝ ρgh·r⁴/(8ηL)。0.38 g 下同一块漏板只出 38% 的玻璃,要么多打 2.64 倍的孔(全是进口铂铑),要么把熔线抬高 2.64 倍。本厂选后者:漏板上方 13 cm 的那段料柱,不是造型,是重力税。
pois.detail_en: A platinum-rhodium bushing with 29 tips hangs at the forehearth's east end; glass at 1250 C flows through them under **its own weight** and is attenuated to 13 microns by winders running at 12.4 m/s, over a gathering wheel, through the sizing applicator, onto the spools. Round one's version of this card said drawing is independent of gravity - **half right**. Attenuation is, but **tip flow is gravity-driven**: Q scales as rho*g*h*r^4/(8*eta*L). At 0.38 g the same bushing delivers only 38% of the glass, so you either drill 2.64x as many tips - all of them imported platinum - or raise the melt head 2.64x. This plant does the latter: the 13 cm column standing above the bushing is not styling, it is the gravity tax.

specs.漏板: Pt/Rh 合金 29 孔,~1 kg(补偿后;不补偿要 78 孔 2.6 kg)
specs.补偿头压: 熔线抬到孔上 13 cm(地球 5 cm)
specs.冷却: 闭式 CO₂ 气罩,冷却段 25 mm(纯辐射要 1.5~5.9 m)
specs.纤维产量: 12 kg/sol(筋 4.1 / 缠绕带 3 / 织物滤布 4.9)

specs_en.Bushing: Pt/Rh, 29 tips, ~1 kg after compensation (78 tips and 2.6 kg without)
specs_en.Flow per tip: 16.6 g/h on Earth, 6.3 g/h on Mars at the same geometry (x0.378)
specs_en.Compensating head: melt line 13 cm above the tips (5 cm on Earth)
specs_en.Cooling: closed CO2 shroud, 25 mm cooling zone (radiation alone would need 1.5-5.9 m)
specs_en.Fiber output: 12 kg/sol (4.1 rebar / 3 winding tape / 4.9 textile and filter cloth)

sim: 替代比不是拍的(账 1):等承载力质量比 (ρ_b/ρ_s)·(σ_s/σ_b)=0.127,再计刚度罚 2×(模量只有钢的 1/4,裂缝控制由刚度定)→ 0.255。按打印机 333 kg/sol 硫混凝土、结构件六成、80 kg 筋/吨计,需求 4.1 kg/sol——产能按消纳定,不造没人用的纤维。
原料的妙处(账 6):原矿 FeO 19.2% 高出地球 CBF 带上沿,纤维会析晶;铸造厂磁选吃走磁铁矿后,尾料 FeO 落到 8.5%,恰在带内。铸造厂的除铁工序,顺手就是本厂的原料预处理——同一吨土再一次被用了两次。
【第二轮自我推翻(账 9)】第一轮把卷绕轮定成 25 rpm,对应线速仅 1.1 m/s——那是为动画好看挑的数,不是算的。由孔流反推真实线速 12.4 m/s,卷绕应是 **282 rpm**,第一轮慢了 11 倍。已改正;代价是低帧率录像会看到车轮倒转(欠采样),所以另加一只排线器往复(0.35 m / 2.4 s),让卷绕段在任何帧率下都读得出在动。
冷却也被火星改写(账 9):地球拉丝靠强制风冷,火星 600 Pa 没有空气可用。纯辐射冷却要 1.5~5.9 m 的落差(发射率不确定区间),塔给不起;解法是**闭式 CO₂ 气罩**——气源就是火星大气,压到 50 kPa 只要 0.23 kWh/kg,冷却段压回 25 mm。

【第四轮:那个区间收窄了,而我有句话说重了(账 19)】账 9 给纯辐射冷却段的是 1.5~5.9 m 的宽区间,宽度全来自一个没算的量——13 µm 纤维的**有效发射率**。它不是材料常数:纤维太细,对近红外是**光学薄**的,ε 由 α·d 定,而 α 在玻璃里跨三个量级(Fe²⁺ 带弱 / Si-O 泛频中 / 多声子不透明)。按 1250 °C 的普朗克谱加权(50% 能量在 2.7 µm 以内、30% 在 2.7~4.5、20% 在 4.5 µm 以外),算得 **ε_eff = 0.316**,冷却段收窄成 **1.9 m**。于是账 9 那句「纯辐射塔给不起」**说重了**:定版工位落差 1.4 m,只差 1.3 倍,加高到 2 m 出头就够。**结论不翻,但理由要换成真的三条**:① 气罩把冷却段压到 25 mm,拉丝工位才矮得下来、才能与熔窑共壳(账 8 的 4.2 kW 全靠这个布置);② 冷却速率可控 = 纤维直径可控,纯辐射的速率由 ε(T) 自己定、调不了;③ CO₂ 气源是压缩火星大气,0.23 kWh/kg,便宜到不值得为省它加高塔。
sim_en: The substitution ratio is derived, not asserted (ledger 1): equal-force mass ratio (rho_b/rho_s)(sigma_s/sigma_b) = 0.127, doubled for the stiffness penalty (a quarter of steel's modulus, and crack control is a stiffness problem) gives 0.255. Against the printer's 333 kg/sol of sulfur concrete, 60% structural, 80 kg of bar per tonne: 4.1 kg/sol. Capacity follows the offtake table - no fiber is made that nobody uses.

The feed trick (ledger 6): raw ore at 19.2% FeO sits above the terrestrial CBF band and would devitrify the fiber. After the foundry's magnetic separation takes the magnetite, its reject lands at 8.5% FeO - inside the band. The foundry's de-ironing step doubles as this plant's feed conditioning: the same tonne of soil, used twice, again.

[Round two overturns round one (ledger 9)] The first pass set the winders at 25 rpm, which corresponds to a draw speed of 1.1 m/s - a number chosen because it animated nicely, not because it was computed. Working the true speed back from tip flow gives 12.4 m/s and **282 rpm**: round one was 11x slow. Fixed - at the cost of wagon-wheel aliasing in low-frame-rate capture, so a traversing guide (0.35 m every 2.4 s) was added so the winding section reads as moving at any frame rate.

Mars rewrites the cooling too (ledger 9): Earth's drawing towers force-cool with air, and at 600 Pa there is no air to use. Radiation alone needs a 1.5-5.9 m drop depending on the fiber's uncertain emissivity - more than the station can give. The answer is a **closed CO2 shroud**: the gas is the Martian atmosphere itself, compressing it to 50 kPa costs 0.23 kWh/kg, and the cooling zone collapses back to 25 mm.

[Round four: the range narrowed, and one of my sentences was too strong (ledger 19)] Ledger 9 gave radiation-only cooling as a wide 1.5-5.9 m band, and the whole width came from one uncomputed quantity - the **effective emissivity** of a 13 micron fiber. It is not a material constant: the fiber is thin enough to be **optically thin** in the near infrared, so epsilon follows alpha*d, and alpha spans three orders of magnitude across the glass spectrum (weak Fe2+ band, moderate Si-O overtones, opaque multiphonon). Weighting by the 1250 C Planck spectrum - 50% of the energy below 2.7 microns, 30% between 2.7 and 4.5, 20% beyond - gives **epsilon_eff = 0.316**, and the cooling length narrows to **1.9 m**. Which makes ledger 9's 'the tower cannot give that' **an overstatement**: the station drops 1.4 m, only 1.3x short, and a tower a little over 2 m would do it. **The conclusion stands, but on three real reasons instead**: (1) the shroud collapses cooling to 25 mm, which is what lets the drawing station sit low enough to share the furnace's enclosure - ledger 8's 4.2 kW depends on that layout; (2) controllable cooling rate means controllable fiber diameter, while radiation-only cooling runs at whatever rate epsilon(T) dictates; (3) the CO2 comes from compressed Martian atmosphere at 0.23 kWh/kg, too cheap to justify a taller tower to avoid it.
pois.physics: 拉丝要同时管住两件事,而 g 只出现在其中一件里:**孔流**是压差驱动的粘性流动(Poiseuille,压头来自 ρgh,所以 ∝ g),**衰减**是拉力与表面张力在冷却史里的赛跑(只看拉速与温度,不看 g)。第一轮只看见后者就下了『与重力无关』的结论——这正是把一个工序当成单一物理过程的典型错误。补偿之所以选抬熔线而不是加铂,也是因为在 0.38 g 下支撑一段料柱的结构代价同样打了 0.38 折。
pois.physics_en: Drawing controls two things at once, and g appears in only one of them: **tip flow** is pressure-driven viscous flow (Poiseuille, with the head coming from rho*g*h, hence proportional to g), while **attenuation** is a race between tension and surface tension along a cooling history (set by speed and temperature, not by g). Round one saw only the second and concluded 'gravity does not matter' - the classic error of treating one process step as one piece of physics. And the reason compensation raises the melt line rather than adding platinum is that at 0.38 g the structure holding that column up is itself 0.38x cheaper.

pois.label: 硫基体拉挤筋线(补上第一轮的一个洞)
pois.label_en: Sulfur-matrix pultrusion (patching a hole in round one)
pois.detail: 九只纱团从纱架引出,经导丝梳进入 140 °C 的液硫浸渍槽(槽面那层琥珀就是液硫),再过成型模、牵引机、定长切断,出来的就是那捆暗黄褐色的纤维筋。第一轮说「BFRP 筋顶掉进口钢筋,黑线物料 100% 本地」——但 BFRP 的 P 是**聚合物基体**,城里没有树脂线,那个 100% 有个洞。本线把洞补上:基体改用硫厂现成的硫,2.0 kg/sol,占其产能 2%。出料端立着一块橙色警示牌,写的是这条线唯一的硬约束:**此构件不得重熔**。
pois.detail_en: Nine spools feed off the creel, through a comb, into a molten sulfur impregnation bath at 140 C - that amber surface is the sulfur - then through the forming die, the puller and the cut-off, and out comes that bundle of dark ochre fiber bar. Round one claimed 'basalt-fiber rebar displaces imported steel, and the black line's material flow is 100% local' - but the P in FRP is a **polymer matrix**, and this city has no resin plant. That 100% had a hole in it. This line patches it: the matrix is sulfur from the plant next door, 2.0 kg/sol, 2% of its output. The orange sign at the outfeed carries this line's one hard constraint: **this member must never be remelted**.

specs.配比: 纤维 60 vol% = 67 wt%,硫 33 wt%,筋密度 2508 kg/m3
specs.力学: 抗拉 1014 MPa,模量 57.4 GPa(混合律,复现第一轮所用值)
specs.锚固长度: 51 倍筋径(钢筋惯例 30~80,设计做得了)
specs.适用范围: **仅室外/覆土构件**(舱内 T/T_m=0.75 落蠕变区)

specs_en.Formulation: 60 vol% fiber = 67 wt%, 33 wt% sulfur; bar density 2508 kg/m3
specs_en.Mechanics: 1014 MPa tensile, 57.4 GPa modulus by rule of mixtures - reproducing round one's figures
specs_en.Development length: 51 bar diameters (rebar practice runs 30-80, so it is designable)
specs_en.Scope: **outdoor and buried members only** - indoors T/Tm = 0.75 is squarely in the creep regime

sim: 换基体没换主角:抗拉与模量由纤维给,混合律算得 1014 MPa / 57.4 GPa,复现第一轮所用的 1000 MPa / 50 GPa——**第一轮的替代比(4.1 kg/sol 顶掉 16 kg/sol 进口钢筋)不变**,变的只是它现在有了合法的基体。
两份白拿的红利:① **碱蚀问题根本不存在**——玄武岩纤维在地球最大的耐久性敌人是波特兰水泥 pH 12.5~13.5 的孔溶液(长期损失 30~60% 强度),而硫混凝土是中性热塑基体。这座城当初选硫是为了省电,顺手把纤维的软肋也解决了。② **热匹配**:筋纵向 CTE 11.9e-6 对硫混凝土 15e-6,70 K 日温摆下全约束热应力仅 12.4 MPa = 抗拉的 1.2%。
火星的冷是硫的朋友,但只在室外:硫熔点 392 K,同系温度 T/T_m 在室外年均只有 **0.56**(安全),夏季正午 0.70(留意),舱内 20 °C 是 **0.75——蠕变区,不许承长期荷载**。所以筋只进室外/覆土结构,舱内承力件仍走铸造厂的铁。
**一条硬冲突,已报 ops-printer-01**:硫混凝土最珍贵的性质是 140 °C 重熔可焊缝、可拆用;但筋的基体也是硫,加热到 140 °C 时筋会跟着化,局部退成一束散纤维,载荷传递当场失效。定版分工:需要重熔维修的构件走**短切纤维增韧、不配筋**;永久受拉构件走连续筋并在图上标死不得重熔;确需维修则先支撑卸载——与地球预应力构件动火同一条纪律。
sim_en: Changing the matrix did not change the protagonist: strength and stiffness come from the fiber, and the rule of mixtures gives 1014 MPa and 57.4 GPa, reproducing the 1000 MPa / 50 GPa used in round one. **The substitution ratio - 4.1 kg/sol displacing 16 kg/sol of imported steel - is unchanged**; what changed is that it now has a matrix the city can actually make.

Two dividends collected for free: (1) **alkali attack simply does not arise** - basalt fiber's worst durability enemy on Earth is the pH 12.5-13.5 pore solution of Portland cement, costing 30-60% of its strength over time, and sulfur concrete is a neutral thermoplastic. The city chose sulfur to save electricity and incidentally cured the fiber's weakness. (2) **Thermal match**: the bar's longitudinal CTE of 11.9e-6 against the concrete's 15e-6 produces just 12.4 MPa of fully restrained stress over a 70 K diurnal swing - 1.2% of tensile.

Mars's cold is sulfur's friend, but only outdoors: sulfur melts at 392 K, and the homologous temperature outdoors averages **0.56** (safe), reaching 0.70 at summer noon (watch it), while a 20 C cabin sits at **0.75 - the creep regime, no sustained load allowed**. So the bar serves outdoor and buried structures only; indoor load paths stay with the foundry's iron.

A hard conflict, reported to ops-printer-01: sulfur concrete's most valuable property is that 140 C remelting welds cracks and allows disassembly - but the bar's matrix is also sulfur, so heating to 140 C melts the bar too, degrading it locally into a bundle of loose fibers and destroying load transfer on the spot. The settled split: members intended for remelt repair get **chopped-fiber toughening and no bar**; permanent tension members get continuous bar and are marked on the drawings as never-remelt; and if such a member must be repaired, it is shored and unloaded first - the same discipline as hot work on prestressed concrete on Earth.
pois.physics: 复合材料的分工:纤维承力,基体传力。基体只需要把载荷剪进纤维,所以它的强度可以低得多——硫的界面剪切只有 5 MPa,代价仅仅是锚固要长 2.4 倍,而 51 倍筋径仍落在钢筋混凝土的常规区间。真正被基体决定的是**使用温度**:热塑基体的上限是它自己的熔点,于是「这根筋能去哪」这个问题,答案写在硫的相图上,不在纤维的强度表上。
pois.physics_en: The division of labour in a composite: fibers carry load, the matrix transfers it. A matrix only has to shear load into the fibers, so it can be far weaker - sulfur's interfacial shear is just 5 MPa, and the price is anchorage 2.4x longer, with 51 bar diameters still inside ordinary reinforced-concrete practice. What the matrix really decides is **service temperature**: a thermoplastic matrix is capped by its own melting point, so the question 'where can this bar go' is answered on sulfur's phase diagram, not on the fiber's strength table.

pois.label: 铸石线(高铁是催化剂不是毒)
pois.label_en: Cast stone line (high iron: catalyst, not poison)
pois.detail: 浇包沿单轨从熔窑接液,倒进模排,再送进析晶退火窑——铸石不是玻璃,是刻意让玻璃反悔的产物:在 800~900 °C 保温,让熔体析出致密的辉石微晶。莫氏硬度 8,耐磨性数倍于钢,专治矿场溜槽、硫厂受料斗这些被磨蚀吃设备的地方。纤维线怕铁,铸石线爱铁:磁铁矿微晶正是析晶的形核剂——所以铸石吃高铁原矿,纤维吃磁选尾料,同一种氧化物,一条线的毒是另一条线的药。
pois.detail_en: The ladle rides its monorail from the melter, pours into the mould row, and the moulds enter the crystallisation lehr. Cast stone is not glass - it is glass deliberately allowed to change its mind: held at 800-900 C, the melt precipitates dense pyroxene microcrystals. Mohs 8, several times steel's abrasion resistance, made for the mine chutes and sulfur-plant hoppers that erosion eats. The fiber line fears iron; the cast line loves it: magnetite microcrystals are the very nucleating agent for crystallisation. So cast stone eats the high-iron raw ore while fiber eats the de-ironed reject - one oxide, poison to one line, medicine to the other.

pois.sim: 0.38 g 的浇注账(与铸造厂同一条铸造学):浇注流速 ∝ √g 打 0.62 折,静压补缩 ∝ g 打 0.38 折——但铸石板是厚壁平板,充型窗口宽裕,两条缩律都咬不到它;真正要防的是析晶阶段的温度梯度,而那是窑的事,与重力无关。铸石是本厂对 0.38 g 最不敏感的产品。
pois.sim_en: The 0.38 g pouring ledger (same foundry science): pour velocity scales with sqrt(g), so 0.62x; riser head with g, so 0.38x. But cast plate is thick-walled and flat - its filling window is generous and neither scaling law bites. What actually needs control is the temperature gradient during crystallisation, and that belongs to the lehr, not to gravity. Cast stone is this plant's least g-sensitive product.
pois.physics: 玻璃陶瓷的原理:玻璃是过冷液体,给它形核剂和一段合适的温度窗口,它会长出比任何浇注组织都细密的晶粒——强度与耐磨来自微晶的细,而细来自形核点的多。Jezero 玄武岩自带 19% 铁,等于原料里预混了形核剂,行星又白送一份地质红利。
pois.physics_en: The glass-ceramic principle: glass is a supercooled liquid, and given nucleating agents plus the right temperature window it grows a grain structure finer than any casting. Strength and wear resistance come from the fineness, and fineness from the abundance of nucleation sites. Jezero basalt ships with 19% iron - nucleant premixed into the ore, one more geological dividend this planet hands over for free.

pois.label: 酸浸提纯撬与透明线的真实体量
pois.label_en: Acid-leach skid, and how small the clear line really is
pois.detail: 透明玻璃的原料不是玄武岩,是三角洲边缘的水成硅沉积——Jezero 有蛋白石探测记录,矿场为此新圈一条选采层位(硫酸盐层的先例)。碎料进热盐酸浸出罐:铁镁钙铝全部溶掉,SiO₂ 不溶留下;含氯母液进喷雾焙烧塔,高温水解回氧化物和 HCl,酸循环回罐——钢厂酸洗线的成熟工艺,试剂闭环,补酸只补泄漏。出来的白料 99.9% SiO₂,配上纯碱与石灰进日池窑。
pois.detail_en: Clear glass does not start from basalt but from the hydrated silica sediments at the delta margin - Jezero carries opaline-silica detections, and the mine flags a new selective-mining horizon for it, on the sulfate-bench precedent. Crushed feed enters hot hydrochloric leach tanks: iron, magnesium, calcium and aluminium all dissolve, silica stays. The chloride liquor goes to a spray roaster where pyrohydrolysis returns oxides plus HCl, and the acid cycles back - the steel industry's pickling-regeneration process, a closed reagent loop where only leakage is made up. The white residue is 99.9% SiO2, batched with soda and lime for the day tank.

sim: 配料闭环(账 6):CaO 来自硫厂尾料——CaS 用大气 CO₂ 碳酸化成 CaCO₃(放出的 H₂S 回 Claus 收硫),煅烧得石灰;MgO 是酸浸副产的内循环。硫厂的尾料的尾料还在被用。唯独钠没有本地来源,纯碱是透明线永远断不了的那根脐带。

【第二轮推翻第一轮】第一轮的 3600 kg/火星年 是我拍的。第二轮去城里**逐件数玻璃**(账 7):村舍 15 扇 ⌀1.6 + 公共舱 ⌀3.1 + 博物馆玻璃前厅 80.7 m² + 玄关观景窗 11 m² + 杂项 = **144 m² 装机 = 4.04 t**。稳态需求(更换 3%/火星年 + 实验器皿 + 容器)只有 **501 kg/火星年**——第一轮高估 **7.2 倍**。那个数不是速率,是建设期:照它跑 1.1 火星年就把全城玻璃装完了。
所以透明线按**项目**排产,不按年速率:博物馆前厅 2260 kg 成品一个项目 = **72 sol 一场战役**;稳态年只开 16 sol(占空 2.4%)。第一轮写的『90 sol/火星年常态』实为项目年的量,高估 5.6 倍——透明线的年电耗随之下修同样倍数。

诚实边界定版(账 2/7/15,第三轮**放松了一档**):**成像级与大口径永远进口**(镜坯 87 天起的精密退火 + 无条纹熔制链);**铅玻璃观察窗**永远进口(无铅源,且还原气氛会把 PbO 还原成金属铅);**Zerodur 类零膨胀微晶**永远进口(需 LAS 锂铝硅体系,城内无锂线);**超薄玻璃 <1 mm** 永远进口(自然厚度 11.2 mm,浮法拉不到)。**但『光学级 100% 永远进口』这句话前两轮划得过严**:退火时间 ∝ L²,50 mm 坯只要 22 天、30 mm 只要 8 天,一台小退火炉在两场战役之间就做完了。定版改为:**≤50 mm 的非成像级光学件(样品窗、观察窗片、载玻片、棱镜与聚光镜坯,Δn ~ 1e-5)本地可做**,约 30 kg/火星年 = 一个 sol 的战役,插得进任何一年。这是全册唯一一次**反向**的自我修正:前两轮把自己的能力说小了。

【采位改由城内实测圈定(账 20;接 sci-orbiter-01 的 SWIR 产品)】此前本卡对硅层的背书只是「Jezero 有轨道蛋白石探测记录」这句文献。现在换成本城自己的测量:400 km 轨道器的 SWIR(1.0–2.6 µm、20 m 像元)按硅质三联带深 1.41 / 1.91 / 2.21 µm ×(1−尘盖)出 200 m 优先级格网,**采位取最高优先级格内的 20 m 像元定点**。核过两件事:**① 相态覆盖对得上**——1.41(羟基)+1.91(分子水)+2.21(Si–OH)正是水成非晶硅的识别三件套,而含水非晶硅恰是盐酸浸出最好剥的那一相(本卡上文)。**② 分辨率是三个数量级的富余**:稳态进料 832 kg/火星年 = 1 m 厚层位下 **0.52 m²/火星年**,一个 20 m 像元就是 **770 火星年**的量;即便叠一场博物馆级战役也够 161 年。**所以这份产品对本厂的价值不在「找到足够多」,在「挑出最好的那一小块」——本厂的约束从来是品位与相态,不是储量。**顺带白拿一处:(1−尘盖)权重会把格网偏向风蚀干净的出露面,那对大宗采矿是偏差,对一年只挖半平方米的本厂**恰好是筛选器**。**一条已回请的边界**:2.21 µm 同时是 Al–OH 的带(蒙脱石 2.21、高岭石 2.17+2.21 双峰),只报三个波长的带深分不开蛋白石与铝黏土,而这两者对本厂并不等价——若圈到的是铝黏土,酸耗 +17%(每 Al 要 3 个 HCl 而非平均 2.4),更要紧的是高岭石耐盐酸,溶不掉的 Al₂O₃ 会留进白料:按 5% 进料计残余达 7 wt%,那已不是钠钙玻璃而是铝硅酸盐,作业温度约抬 +49 °C——对一座 1450 °C、耐火砖 8 火星年一代的小窑(账 8)是硬成本。**该册已答,零硬件代价**:仪器本是 160 段 × 10 nm 连续谱,2.16/2.21/2.26 µm 通道一直在采,「只报三个波长」只是首版产品格式。格网 v4 每格新增 D₂.₁₆(高岭石 2.16/2.21 双峰肩深,间距 50 nm = 5 个采样通道)、ASYM₂.₂₁ = BD₂.₂₆/BD₂.₂₁(蛋白石宽右肩 FWHM 60~80 nm 对蒙脱石窄对称 ~30 nm)、相标志 {蛋白石/高岭石/蒙脱石/混合存疑} + 置信度,形状量按格内 ~100 像素叠栈(SNR ×10)后出,透明线评分补相罚项。**两级分工定版**:光谱相判别是初筛,「存疑」格仍走采样 + sci-lab-01 XRD 复核——**格网定候选,XRD 定采。**
sim_en: Closing the batch (ledger 6): CaO comes from the sulfur plant's tailings - CaS carbonated with atmospheric CO2 to CaCO3 (the H2S released goes back to Claus), then calcined to lime; MgO is the leach by-product, recycled internally. The tailings of the tailings are still being used. Only sodium has no local source, and soda ash is the umbilical the clear line never cuts.

[Round two overturns round one] The 3600 kg per Mars year of the first pass was asserted. Round two went and **counted the city's glass** (ledger 7): 15 village windows at 1.6 m, the commons at 3.1 m, the museum's 80.7 m2 glazed foyer, the 11 m2 foyer viewport, plus sundries = **144 m2 installed, 4.04 t**. Steady demand - 3% a year replacement plus labware plus containers - is only **501 kg per Mars year**, so round one overstated it **7.2x**. That figure was never a rate; it was a build-out, and at that rate the city's entire glazing would be finished in 1.1 Mars years.

So the clear line is scheduled by **project**, not by annual rate: the museum foyer's 2260 kg of finished glass is **one 72-sol campaign**, while a steady year fires only 16 sol, a 2.4% duty. Round one's '90 sol per Mars year, routine' was really a project year's worth - 5.6x over - and the line's annual power falls by the same factor.

The honest boundary, settled (ledgers 2, 7, 15 - round three **loosened it by one notch**): **imaging-grade and large blanks are imported forever** (87 days of precision annealing and a striae-free melting chain); **leaded viewing glass** forever (no lead source, and a reducing atmosphere would reduce PbO to metal); **Zerodur-class zero-expansion ceramic** forever (needs the lithium-alumino-silicate system, and there is no lithium line); **ultra-thin sheet below 1 mm** forever (the natural thickness is 11.2 mm and float cannot attenuate that far). **But 'optical grade, 100% imported' was drawn too strictly in the first two rounds**: annealing time scales with L squared, so a 50 mm blank needs 22 days and a 30 mm blank 8 - a small lehr finishes either between campaigns. Settled position: **non-imaging optics up to 50 mm are made locally** (sample windows, viewport discs, slides, prism and condenser blanks at about 1e-5 homogeneity), roughly 30 kg a Mars year, one sol of campaign, schedulable in any year. This is the volume's only **reverse** self-correction: the first two rounds undersold what the plant can do.

[The mining horizon is now fixed by a city measurement (ledger 20; from sci-orbiter-01's SWIR product)] Until now this card's only warrant for the silica horizon was the literature line 'Jezero has orbital opal detections'. That is replaced by a measurement the city made itself: the 400 km orbiter's SWIR imager (1.0-2.6 um, 20 m pixels) publishes a 200 m priority grid from the silica triplet band depths at 1.41 / 1.91 / 2.21 um weighted by (1 - dust cover), and **the horizon is now sited on the 20 m pixel inside the highest-priority cell**. Two things were checked. **(1) The phase coverage matches**: 1.41 (hydroxyl), 1.91 (molecular water) and 2.21 (Si-OH) are the standard identification triplet for water-laid amorphous silica - which is precisely the phase that leaches most cleanly in hydrochloric acid, as this card argues above. **(2) The resolution is three orders of magnitude more than needed**: steady feed is 832 kg per Mars year, which over a 1 m horizon is **0.52 m2 per Mars year**, so a single 20 m pixel holds **770 Mars years** of feedstock - 161 even with a museum-scale campaign stacked on top. **So this product's value here is not 'finding enough' but 'picking the best small patch': this plant has always been constrained by grade and phase, never by tonnage.** A free bonus: the (1 - dust cover) weighting biases the grid toward wind-scoured exposures, which is a bias for bulk mining and a **filter** for a plant that needs half a square metre a year. **One boundary, already referred back**: 2.21 um is also the Al-OH band (montmorillonite at 2.21, kaolinite a 2.17+2.21 doublet), so three band depths alone cannot separate opal from aluminous clay - and the two are not equivalent here. Clay would cost 17% more acid (three HCl per aluminium rather than the 2.4 average), and worse, kaolinite resists hydrochloric acid, so undissolved Al2O3 rides into the white product: at 5% of the feed that is 7 wt% residual, which is no longer soda-lime glass but an aluminosilicate, raising working temperature by about 49 C - a hard cost for a 1450 C furnace whose refractory lasts eight Mars years (ledger 8). **That volume has answered, at zero hardware cost**: the instrument is a 160-band, 10 nm continuous spectrometer that has always sampled the 2.16 / 2.21 / 2.26 um channels - 'three wavelengths only' was a first-version product format. Grid v4 adds per cell D2.16 (kaolinite 2.16/2.21 doublet shoulder depth, a 50 nm spacing = five sampling channels), ASYM2.21 = BD2.26/BD2.21 (opal's broad right shoulder, FWHM 60-80 nm, against montmorillonite's narrow symmetric ~30 nm), a phase flag {opal / kaolinite / montmorillonite / mixed-uncertain} with confidence, shape metrics computed after stacking the ~100 pixels in a cell (SNR x10), and a phase penalty in the clear-line score. **The two-tier division is now settled**: spectral phase identification is a first screen, and 'uncertain' cells still go through sampling plus XRD at sci-lab-01 - **the grid picks candidates, XRD picks the mine.**
pois.physics: 酸浸能提纯是因为硅酸盐网络的差异:蛋白石是水成的非晶 SiO₂,在盐酸里近乎惰性;而共生的铁镁碳酸盐与细粒氧化物是离子晶格,质子攻击即解体。选盐酸不选碳氯化,是因为碳氯化买到的是半导体纯度——窗玻璃用不着,芯片厂的多晶硅线自己会做。工艺纯度只买到该买的那一档,是这册的选型纪律。
pois.physics_en: Acid leaching purifies because of a difference in silicate networks: opal is water-laid amorphous SiO2, nearly inert to hydrochloric acid, while the accompanying Fe/Mg carbonates and fine oxides are ionic lattices that proton attack dismantles. HCl was chosen over carbochlorination because carbochlorination buys semiconductor purity - windows do not need it, and the fab runs its own polysilicon line. Buying exactly the purity grade the product needs is this volume's selection discipline.

pois.label: 浮法段:0.38 g 的自然厚度(全册招牌)
pois.label_en: Float bath: natural thickness at 0.38 g (the flagship card)
pois.detail: 玻璃液摊在熔融锡面上,重力压平它、表面张力收拢它,两者平衡出一个『自然厚度』——地球上是 6.9 mm,全世界的浮法线都从这个数出发。t=√(2σΔρ/(g·ρ_t·ρ_g)) ∝ 1/√g:火星的自然厚度是 11.2 mm,厚 1.63 倍。反直觉的是,这在本城是红利:70 kPa 舱压下 ⌀3.1 m 球面端窗(掩土村公共舱那扇)的膜应力厚度恰是 12.5 mm——火星浮法躺着就产出舱窗厚度,一片成型,免拉伸免叠层。要是做平板窗得 134 mm,差 11 倍,所以端窗全做球面。付税的是薄板:温室 4 mm 镶装板的拉薄比从 1.72 涨到 2.81,边辊组多一档。
pois.detail_en: Molten glass spreads on liquid tin; gravity flattens it, surface tension gathers it, and the balance settles at a natural thickness - 6.9 mm on Earth, the number every float line starts from. t = sqrt(2*sigma*d_rho/(g*rho_t*rho_g)) scales as 1/sqrt(g): on Mars the natural thickness is 11.2 mm, 1.63x thicker. Counterintuitively that is a dividend here: at 70 kPa cabin pressure, the membrane-stress thickness of the village commons' 3.1 m spherical end window is 12.5 mm - Martian float glass produces window-grade thickness lying down, one pane, no attenuation, no lamination. A flat window would need 134 mm, eleven times more, which is why every end window is a spherical cap. The tax falls on thin sheet: 4 mm greenhouse glazing needs a stretch ratio of 2.81 instead of 1.72, one more bank of edge rollers.

锡浴保护气的正面回答:CO₂ 不行。Ellingham 账——热端 1050 °C 纯 CO₂ 的平衡氧分压 2.4e-5 bar,比 Sn/SnO₂ 平衡的 4.1e-13 高出近 8 个数量级,全温区氧化锡,浮渣和锡雾斑会毁掉每一片板。地球用 N₂+H₂,火星的等价物是 res-eclss-01 的天然 N₂58/Ar42 缓冲气掺 5% ISRU 循环氢:允许 H₂O/H₂ 高达 4.7,普通干燥度就够。地球当空气白拿的氮,这里 5.27 kWh/kg 记账——所以浴体密封做到 2 kg/sol 补气,气也是钱。

【第二轮:招牌卡长出一条全城设计律(账 7)】既然球面窗只要 12.5 mm 而平板窗要 173 mm,那平板到底能做多大?把 12.5 mm 板反代回平板弯曲式,70 kPa 下的跨度上限只有 **209 mm**——**这撞上了飞机舷窗的已知答案**(0.2~0.4 m,又小又厚,原因相同)。于是有了一条可以贴在全城设计手册上的判据:**增压舱的玻璃,要么小于约 0.2 m,要么是曲面,没有第三种。**顺带自纠一处:第一轮算 ⌀3.1 m 平板圆窗用了长条系数 0.75,圆板简支应是 1.24,正确值是 173 mm 而非 134——结论不变,更不成立。
同一种 CO₂,两种身份(账 9 的镜像):锡浴里 CO₂ 是毒药(氧化锡,差 8 个数量级),而在拉丝冷却罩里它是**免费的冷却剂**——压缩火星大气只要 0.23 kWh/kg,比 eclss 的 N₂/Ar 便宜 23 倍。区别只在于被保护的东西还能不能再被氧化:锡能,玻璃已经是氧化物,不能。

【第三轮:招牌卡被安全限定(账 12)】前两轮只问过这片玻璃够不够强、保不保温,没问过破了会怎样。整窗脱落的泄压时标是 **134 ms**,没有生存路径;裂缝工况是 5.6 min,可以处置。所以承压舱窗**必须双层冗余**,单层方案只留给不承压玻璃。自然厚度红利本身没有损伤——两片各 11.2 mm 依然是浮法直接给的厚度,依然不拉不叠;变的只是「一片」变成「两片」,而账 10 早就想要第二片了。详见窗组件卡。

【第四轮:敞开的车间怎么养一池不许沾尘的锡(账 18)】第二轮把厂房定成敞开防尘棚(不增压),第一轮又要求锡浴维持还原气氛——两条摆在一起是有张力的,前三轮都只挂在诚实清单上。算完是这样:**低压本身就是最大的一份红利**——锡浴与外界同压(610 Pa 加几十 Pa 正压)时,同体积保护气的质量只有地球的 **1/166**;而还原性由 5% H₂ 的**比值**决定,与总压无关(账 3 的 H₂O/H₂≤4.7 是比值判据)。缝口 0.2 m/s 的外流对 2 µm 尘 4.6 mm/s 的沉降末速压制 **44 倍**,尘进不来;补气实算 **1.56 kg/sol**,与第二轮所报 2 kg/sol 相差 22%。**地球浮法线最贵的消耗品之一,在火星是全册少有的比地球便宜的一项。**
但账 18 也纠正一处:**防尘不能只封锡浴本体**。玻璃带从日池窑走到锡浴口约 150 s,这段若敞在棚下,落到带面的尘覆盖率虽只有 4.7 ppm,可**每一粒被压进 1050 °C 软玻璃的尘都是一个永久缺陷点**(结石与气泡核)。定版:熔窑→锡浴→镀膜这一整段同压罩起来(场上那顶半透罩子就是它),罩体每 sol 换气三次的增补气不到 0.001 kg——**低压让这条纠正几乎不花钱**。
sim_en: The gate (ledger 3): sigma_eff is back-calibrated from Earth's known 6.9 mm (0.95 N/m), then extrapolated by sqrt(9.81/3.71) = 1.626 - formula and calibration gated separately, so the thickening factor is not a fit.

The cover-gas question answered head-on: CO2 will not do. The Ellingham ledger - at the 1050 C hot end, pure CO2 holds an equilibrium oxygen pressure of 2.4e-5 bar, nearly eight orders above the Sn/SnO2 equilibrium at 4.1e-13. It oxidises tin across the whole bath, and dross plus tin bloom would ruin every sheet. Earth uses N2 + H2; the Martian equivalent is res-eclss-01's natural N2 58/Ar 42 buffer gas with 5% ISRU loop hydrogen. The allowable H2O/H2 is a generous 4.7, so ordinary drying suffices. But nitrogen that Earth takes free from the sky is booked here at 5.27 kWh/kg - hence a bath sealed down to 2 kg/sol of makeup. Gas is money too.

[Round two: the flagship card grows a city-wide design law (ledger 7)] If a spherical window needs 12.5 mm where a flat one needs 173 mm, how big can a flat pane get? Substituting 12.5 mm back into the plate-bending formula gives a span limit of just **209 mm** at 70 kPa - **which lands on the known answer of aircraft windows** (0.2-0.4 m, small and thick, for exactly this reason). That yields a criterion worth pinning up city-wide: **pressurised glazing is either smaller than about 0.2 m or it is curved; there is no third option.** One self-correction along the way: round one used the long-strip coefficient 0.75 for the flat circular window; a simply-supported circular plate takes 1.24, so the right figure is 173 mm, not 134 - the conclusion is unchanged, only more emphatic.

One gas, two identities (the mirror of ledger 9): in the tin bath CO2 is poison - it oxidises tin by eight orders of magnitude - while in the fiber cooling shroud it is a **free coolant**, compressed out of the Martian atmosphere for 0.23 kWh/kg, 23x cheaper than the ECLSS nitrogen-argon. The only difference is whether the thing being protected can still be oxidised: tin can; glass is already an oxide and cannot.

[Round three: the flagship is qualified by safety (ledger 12)] The first two rounds asked whether this pane was strong enough and warm enough, never what happens when it breaks. Losing a whole pane vents the cabin with a **134 ms** time constant - no survivable path - while a crack gives 5.6 minutes, which is manageable. So pressure windows **must be double**, and the single-pane solution belongs to non-pressure glazing only. The natural-thickness dividend itself is untouched: both panes are still exactly what the bath delivers, neither attenuated nor laminated. Only 'one' became 'two' - and ledger 10 already wanted the second one. See the window-assembly card.

[Round four: how do you keep a dust-free tin bath in an open shed (ledger 18)] Round two made the plant an open dust canopy while round one demanded a reducing atmosphere over the tin - a tension all three rounds left sitting on the honest list. Computed, it resolves well: **the low pressure is itself the dividend**. With the bath at ambient pressure plus a few tens of pascals, the same volume of cover gas weighs **1/166** of Earth's, while the reducing power depends on the 5% hydrogen **ratio**, not the total pressure (ledger 3's H2O/H2 <= 4.7 is a ratio criterion). A 0.2 m/s outflow through the ribbon slots beats the 4.6 mm/s settling speed of 2 micron dust by **44x**, so nothing gets in; makeup gas computes to **1.56 kg/sol** against the 2 kg/sol reported in round two, a 22% difference. **One of the most expensive consumables on an Earth float line is, on Mars, one of the few items that is genuinely cheaper.**

Ledger 18 also corrects one thing: **sealing the bath alone is not enough**. The ribbon takes about 150 s to travel from the day tank to the bath entrance, and although only 4.7 ppm of its surface would be covered by dust over that stretch in the open, **every grain pressed into glass at 1050 C is a permanent defect** - a stone or a bubble nucleus. Settled: the whole melter-to-bath-to-coater run is enclosed under one purged hood (the translucent enclosure on the pad), and three air changes a sol adds under 0.001 kg of gas - **low pressure makes this correction almost free**.
pois.physics: 自然厚度是能量最小化的解:摊薄增加表面能,堆厚抬升重心。g 变小,压平的那一方退让,平衡向厚移动——公式里 g 在分母下的根号里,所以是 1/√g。同一条根号也写在毛细长度里:火星熔池的表面波更长、更平,微型线反而更容易保平整。
pois.physics_en: Natural thickness is an energy minimisation: spreading thinner adds surface energy, piling thicker raises the centre of mass. Lower g weakens the flattening side and the balance moves thicker - g sits under the square root in the denominator, hence 1/sqrt(g). The same root appears in the capillary length: surface waves on a Martian bath are longer and flatter, so the micro-line actually holds flatness more easily.

pois.label: 窗组件样件(破了会怎样·会被磨浑·要付多少剂量)
pois.label_en: Window assembly (what if it breaks, hazes, or lets radiation in)
pois.detail: 托架上这件展品把三本账压成一个构造:**双层球冠**,每片 11.2 mm 各自独立承 70 kPa;三圈框由内到外是暗色间隔框、浅色**热断开框**、外框;腔面那圈细栅是**静电除尘幕**的透明电极;后面掀开 60° 的是**覆土窗盖**。前两轮把「一片 12.5 mm 成型」当成纯红利,只问过够不够强、保不保温,从没问过破了会怎样。第三轮问了,答案是:**结构上一片够,安全上一片不够**。
pois.detail_en: This piece on the stand compresses three ledgers into one assembly: a **double spherical cap**, each 11.2 mm pane independently able to hold 70 kPa; three frame rings - dark spacer, pale **thermal break**, outer frame; the fine grid on the cavity face is the transparent electrode of an **electrostatic dust curtain**; and the disc hinged open behind it is the **regolith shutter**. The first two rounds treated 'one 12.5 mm pane' as a pure dividend, asking only whether it was strong enough and warm enough, never what happens when it breaks. Round three asked, and the answer is: **one pane is enough structurally and not enough for safety**.

specs.构造: 双层球冠 11.2 + 11.2 mm,腔面镀膜,间隔 12 mm
specs.整窗脱落: 泄压时标 **134 ms** —— 无生存路径
specs.裂缝工况: 3 m × 1 mm 裂缝泄压时标 5.6 min —— 可撤离可封堵
specs.钢化方式: **化学钢化**;物理钢化在承压窗上禁用(碎即全脱)
specs.外片寿命: 10.4 火星年(雾度到 4%),只换外片 211 kg/插单 7 sol

specs_en.Build-up: double spherical cap, 11.2 + 11.2 mm, coated cavity face, 12 mm gap
specs_en.Crack case: a 3 m x 1 mm crack gives 5.6 min - evacuate and patch
specs_en.Tempering: **chemical**; thermal toughening is banned on pressure windows - it dices and sheds
specs_en.Outer pane life: 10.4 Mars years to 4% haze; replace the outer pane only, 211 kg, 7-sol lead time

sim: **失效模式比强度重要**(账 12):整窗脱落时舱内 200 m³ 经 7.55 m² 开口壅塞流失,泄压时标 **134 ms**——没有任何反应时间;而 3 m 长 1 mm 裂缝是 **5.6 min**,差 2500 倍。所以设计要争取的是「裂而不脱」:退火与化学钢化碎成大块、多数仍卡在框内;**物理钢化碎成小颗粒整片脱落,在承压窗上是被禁止的**——账 5 说薄板用化学钢化是为了绕开风冷难题,这里是为了保命,同一个选择的第二个、也是更硬的理由。

**招牌卡被限定,不是被推翻**:第二轮结论「单层+外镀膜 U=1.21 优于裸双层 1.53」只对**不承压玻璃**成立(博物馆玻璃前厅、室内隔断);承压舱窗因安全必须双层,镀膜随之移到腔面,U=1.02——而这恰好是账 10 四种做法里最好的那个。**安全约束与热工约束指向同一个方案,第二片玻璃两边都在挣钱。**而自然厚度红利毫发无损:两片各 11.2 mm 仍是浮法直接给的厚度,仍然不拉不叠。

**热断裂的风险不在玻璃,在框**(账 12 第二处自我修正):我第一稿只算了「孤立薄板向外散热」,据此宣称必须钢化;补上向舱内的散热后(内侧占总散热 73%),太阳直射造成的边-心温差只有 3 K、应力 1.9 MPa,**连退火玻璃都晒不裂**。真正危险的是框:框若做成冷桥直通外部结构,边-心温差 40 K、应力 25 MPa,是许用的 5 倍。所以这是一条**对窗框的要求**——框必须热断开,把边部温度控制在玻璃平均温度 ±10 K 内。

**尘不会打破窗,但会磨浑它**(账 13):舱窗积尘 0.042%/sol(落在 MER 水平面 0.28 与 sci-ir-01 带罩锗窗 0.027 两个实测锚点之间),透光损失到 10% 需 238 sol,每火星年清洗 2.8 次。火星尘里有 2 种矿物(石英、橄榄石)硬于钠钙玻璃**也硬于 SnO₂:F 硬膜**,**一律不许干擦**——带尘干擦等于拿它们当研磨剂。清洗以腔面静电幕为主、气吹松尘后软刷为辅。外片雾度到 4% 需 10.4 火星年,于是**外片天然是牺牲层**(ISS scratch pane 同一职能):到寿只换外片,不动承压内片。

**开一扇窗要付多少剂量**(账 14):双层玻璃面密度 5.6 g/cm²,而 2 m 覆土是 320——**窗在辐射上等于没有屏蔽**。按立体角份额 3.6% 算,舱内年剂量 6.2(hab-village-01 当时值,该册现改 7.6;本册账 16 逐几何给 41,见 HANDOFF ⑲) → **14.5 mSv/yr(2.3 倍)**,增量折合 **22 sol 的 8 小时 EVA**。缓解是可执行的:配一只 ~420 kg 的覆土窗盖(ops-printer-01 可造),白天开 8 h、其余闭盖 → 8.9 mSv/yr;**而且同一只盖子把账 10 那个夜间热洞也一起堵上了**。本册只给数,开多大窗归居住册裁定。

【第四轮:那道静电幕被我放错了面(账 17)】账 13 说「电极印在内层玻璃的腔面」——**错的**。尘落在外片的**外表面**,而叉指电极的场只在约一个间距的尺度内衰减殆尽:0.4 mm 间距的场,穿不过 11 mm 玻璃 + 12 mm 气腔 + 11 mm 玻璃(合计 85 个间距)去够到外面。**隔着窗擦不了窗外的灰。**定版:电极印在外片外表面;承压窗上它与腔面的低辐射率膜**分处两面**,图纸必须分开标,否则会被做成一面。

【帕邢又一次出场(账 17)】电极既然在外面,就泡在 600 Pa 的 CO₂ 里。用 pwr-grid-01 那套 Townsend 系数复算,CO₂ 在 610 Pa 的**帕邢最小击穿是 249 V @ 1.17 mm**(与该册逐位一致)——mm 间距的电极加到几百伏就放电。解法与他们相反而同源:他们靠**消灭气隙**(≥250 V 处处灌封),本厂靠**把气隙做得比雪崩长度还小**——间距压到 **0.4 mm** 就落进帕邢左支,Townsend 判据无解,气体在任何电压下都不击穿,于是敢加 ±400 V、场强 1.0 MV/m。功耗峰值 0.20 W/m²,按每 10 sol 开 5 分钟的占空,全城平均 **9.7 mW**——账 13 说的「W 级」量级对了,而且偏保守。**要对抗的也不是重力**:2 µm 尘的范德华黏附是它自重的 7.4 万倍,除尘从来不是把灰抖下来,是把它从表面撕开;单靠库仑力只有黏附的 0.4%,EDS 有效靠的是行波场里的介电泳与滚动跳跃——这条**如实标注为文献机理,不冒充推导**。

【第四轮:上了 Geant4,把账 14 的近似换成真输运——结果推翻了我自己(账 16)】求解器 Geant4 11.2.2(Ubuntu HEP 虚拟机),Shielding 物理表,GCR 质子力场调制谱,四工况 × 三点(近窗/舱心/舱尾),共 33 万发原初粒子。**先自检绝对标度**:裸地表吸收剂量率 **0.154 mGy/day**,对 MSL/RAD 实测 0.210 是 0.74 倍——偏低方向正确(本轮只跑质子,GCR 里的 α 与 HZE 另有 20~40%)。**结果**:窗的相对影响是 **1.25×**,而账 14 的立体角近似给的是 2.34×,**高估了 1.9 倍**。三个原因解析式都看不见:窗井本身是准直器、窗朝水平只见半边天、舱内剂量本就以覆土里生成的次级为主。**但绝对增量反而蒙对了**:账 14 说窗加 8.3 mSv/yr,真输运给 10.4——比值高估与基准低估方向相反,几乎抵消。**这条值得记:终值合理不等于过程对。**

【空间梯度:近似给不出的那一半(账 16)】近窗 63 vs 舱尾 40 mSv/yr,差 1.55 倍。**「坐在窗边」和「睡在舱尾」不是一回事**:窗边座位每年多付 23 mSv = 59 sol 的 EVA,舱尾床位只多付 2 mSv = 5 sol。**最便宜的缓解不是窗盖,是排座位**:床位放远窗端、长时工位不贴窗,不花一分钱。其余工况:闭盖(0.35 m 覆土)把近窗点从 63 压到 68 mSv/yr(削 -8%);**而窗井本身就是屏蔽**:窗与覆土端面齐平(整个端盖暴露)时舱内平均 77 mSv/yr,是缩在 2 m 窗井底那版(51)的 1.49 倍;地台加深到 6 m 的定界工况给削减 4.7×(对三点均值 5.7× 变化不大;舱心口径 5.2×);

【第四轮:我报出去的那条建议是错的,已撤回(账 16)】第三轮我建议给每扇舱窗配 0.35 m 覆土盖,说白天开 8 h 可把剂量削一半,并把它报给了掩土村。**真输运说它几乎不起作用**:C/B = **1.03 ± 0.08**,与「无效」一致,与「削一半」相差 7σ。机理清楚:0.35 m 覆土只有 **56 g/cm²**,而本模型实测的等效衰减长度是 183 g/cm²(三点均值口径),纯指数也只有 1.34×,次级建成再把这点收益吃掉。**任何「掀得动」的厚度都落在次级建成区。**而错因与我批评掩土村 38× 的那个错**是同一个**:我在账 14 里默认「挡住立体角就等比例挡住剂量」,等于隐含了指数衰减——**我在同一本册子里犯了自己指出的错,只是换了个形式。**修正后:窗盖的价值只剩热账(账 10 的夜间热洞是真的),剂量上它不是缓解手段。

【但有一件事确实管用,而且是本轮最有操作性的一条(工况 F)】把窗**后退做成井**。实测:窗与覆土端面齐平时舱内 **77 mSv/yr**,缩进 2 m 窗井底只有 **51**,覆土无窗 **41**——**窗井值 1.49 倍剂量,而盖子值 1.00 倍**。同样是「挡住窗前的天空」,为什么一个有效一个无效?**因为盖子挡的是质量,井挡的是立体角。** 质量会被强子级联反噬(次级建成),而立体角不会——井壁把窗能看见的天空削掉一大半,削掉多少就是多少。**挡质量会被级联反噬,挡视野不会**——这是本轮最该带走的一句话,也解释了为什么「排座位」(见上条)那么便宜有效:它挡的也是视野。
sim_en: **Failure mode matters more than strength** (ledger 12): lose the whole pane and 200 m3 of cabin vents through 7.55 m2 of choked orifice with a **134 ms** time constant - no reaction time at all; a 3 m by 1 mm crack gives **5.6 min**, 2500x more. So the design goal is 'crack, do not shed': annealed and chemically strengthened glass breaks into large pieces that mostly stay in the frame, while **thermally toughened glass dices and sheds, which is why it is banned on pressure windows**. Ledger 5 chose chemical strengthening for thin sheet to dodge a convection problem; here the same choice is made to stay alive.

**The flagship is qualified, not overturned**: round two's 'coated single pane at U = 1.21 beats an uncoated double at 1.53' holds only for **non-pressure glazing** - the museum foyer, interior partitions. Pressure windows must be double for safety, which moves the coating to the cavity face and gives U = 1.02 - the best of ledger 10's four options. **Safety and thermal constraints point at the same build-up; the second pane earns its keep twice.** And the natural-thickness dividend is untouched: both panes are still exactly what the bath delivers, neither attenuated nor laminated.

**The thermal fracture risk is not in the glass, it is in the frame** (ledger 12's second self-correction): my first draft modelled an isolated sheet radiating outward only and concluded that tempering was mandatory. Adding the inward path to the cabin - which carries 73% of the heat - drops the sun-driven edge-to-centre difference to 3 K and 1.9 MPa, so **even annealed glass will not crack in sunlight**. What is dangerous is the frame: run it as a cold bridge to the outside structure and the difference reaches 40 K and 25 MPa, five times allowable. This is therefore **a requirement on the frame** - it must be thermally broken, holding the edge within 10 K of the glass mean.

**Dust will not break the window, it will haze it** (ledger 13): deposition on a cabin window runs 0.042%/sol, between the two measured anchors of 0.28 on MER's horizontal panels and 0.027 on sci-ir-01's hooded germanium window. Ten percent transmission loss takes 238 sol, so cleaning happens 2.8 times a Mars year. Martian dust contains two minerals - quartz and olivine - harder than soda-lime glass **and harder than the SnO2:F coating**, so **dry wiping is forbidden**: it turns the dust into lapping compound. Cleaning is primarily an electrostatic curtain on the cavity face, with gas-blow-then-soft-brush as backup. The outer pane reaches 4% haze in 10.4 Mars years, which makes it **naturally the sacrificial layer** - ISS's scratch pane by another name.

**What a window costs in dose** (ledger 14): double glazing is 5.6 g/cm2 of areal density against 320 for 2 m of regolith, so **a window is no shielding at all**. At a 3.6% solid-angle share the cabin's annual dose goes 6.2 (the village volume's value at the time, since revised to 7.6; ledger 16 gives 41 by transport, see handoff 19) to **14.5 mSv/yr, a factor of 2.3**, and the increment equals **22 sol of eight-hour EVA**. The mitigation is buildable: a roughly 420 kg regolith shutter (ops-printer-01 can print it), open eight hours a sol, brings it to 8.9 mSv/yr - **and the same lid also plugs ledger 10's night-time heat hole**. This volume supplies the numbers; how big a window the city wants is the habitat book's call.

[Round four: that dust curtain was on the wrong face (ledger 17)] Ledger 13 said the electrodes go on the cavity face of the inner pane - **wrong**. Dust lands on the **outer** surface of the outer pane, and an interdigitated electrode's field decays within about one pitch: a 0.4 mm pitch field cannot reach across 11 mm of glass, a 12 mm cavity and another 11 mm of glass - 85 pitches away. **You cannot wipe the dust outside a window from inside it.** Settled: electrodes on the outer face, which on a pressure window means they sit on the opposite face from the cavity-side low-e coating - and the drawings must say so, or it will be built as one film on one face.

[Paschen, again (ledger 17)] With the electrodes outside, they sit in 600 Pa of CO2. Recomputing with pwr-grid-01's Townsend coefficients, the Paschen minimum for CO2 at 610 Pa is **249 V at 1.17 mm** - matching that volume digit for digit - so a millimetre-pitch electrode discharges at a few hundred volts. The fix is their fix inverted: they **eliminate the gas gap** (everything above 250 V is potted), while this plant **makes the gap shorter than an avalanche** - drop the pitch to **0.4 mm** and the Townsend criterion has no solution at all, so the gas cannot break down at any voltage, which allows plus/minus 400 V and 1.0 MV/m. Peak draw is 0.20 W/m2, and at five minutes every ten sol the city-wide average is **9.7 mW** - ledger 13's 'watts' was the right order and conservative. **And the enemy is not gravity**: van der Waals adhesion on a 2 micron grain is 74,000 times its weight, so dust removal is never about shaking dust off, it is about tearing it loose. Coulomb force alone reaches only 0.4% of adhesion; EDS works through dielectrophoresis and rolling in the travelling wave - recorded here as **cited mechanism, not something this ledger derived**.

[Round four: Geant4 replaced the approximation, and overturned my own number (ledger 16)] Solver: Geant4 11.2.2 on the Ubuntu HEP VM, Shielding physics list, force-field-modulated GCR proton spectrum, four configurations by three scoring points, 330,000 primaries. **Absolute self-check first**: bare-surface absorbed dose rate comes out at **0.154 mGy/day** against MSL/RAD's measured 0.210, a factor of 0.74 - low in the right direction, since this run carries protons only and GCR alphas and heavy ions add another 20-40%. **Result**: the window's relative effect is **1.25x**, where ledger 14's solid-angle estimate said 2.34x - an **overestimate of 1.9x**. Three reasons the analytic model could not see: the window well acts as a collimator, a horizontal window sees only half the sky, and cabin dose is dominated by secondaries born in the regolith anyway. **Yet the absolute increment was accidentally right**: ledger 14 said the window adds 8.3 mSv/yr and transport gives 10.4 - the overestimated ratio and the underestimated baseline nearly cancelled. **Worth remembering: a plausible final number is not evidence of a sound derivation.**

[The spatial gradient, which the approximation could not give (ledger 16)] 63 mSv/yr beside the window against 40 at the far end, a factor of 1.55. **Sitting by the window and sleeping at the far end are not the same thing**: a window seat costs an extra 23 mSv a year, or 59 sol of EVA, while a far-end bunk costs 5 sol. **The cheapest mitigation is not a shutter, it is the seating plan**: bunks away from the window, long-duration workstations off the glass, at zero cost. The bounding case with the ground slab deepened to 6 m gives a reduction of 4.7x (little change from the three-point mean 5.7x; cabin-centre 5.2x), so the model's known leak does not move the conclusion.

[Round four: a recommendation I had already filed turned out wrong, and has been retracted (ledger 16)] In round three I proposed a 0.35 m regolith shutter for every cabin window, claimed it would halve the dose when closed sixteen hours a sol, and sent that to the village volume. **Transport says it does essentially nothing**: C/B = **1.03 ± 0.08**, consistent with no effect and 7 sigma away from 'halved'. The mechanism is plain: 0.35 m of regolith is only **56 g/cm2**, against an effective attenuation length of 183 g/cm² (three-point mean) measured in this very model, so even pure exponential attenuation would give 1.34x - and secondary buildup eats that. **Any thickness light enough to swing on a hinge sits in the buildup regime.** And the error is the *same* error I had just criticised in the village's 38x: ledger 14 assumed that blocking solid angle blocks dose proportionally, which silently assumes exponential attenuation. **I made the mistake I had flagged, in the same volume, wearing different clothes.** Corrected: the shutter's value is thermal only (ledger 10's night-time heat hole is real); it is not a dose mitigation.

[But one thing does work, and it is the most actionable result of the round (case F)] **Recess the window into a well.** Measured: with the window flush to the berm face the cabin sits at **77 mSv/yr**; recessed at the bottom of a 2 m well it is **51**; with no window at all, **41**. **The well is worth 1.49x in dose, while the shutter is worth 1.00x.** Both are 'blocking the sky in front of the window' - so why does one work and the other not? **Because the shutter blocks mass and the well blocks solid angle.** Mass gets paid back by the hadronic cascade through secondary buildup; solid angle does not - whatever fraction of the sky the well walls remove stays removed. **Blocking mass is punished by the cascade; blocking view is not** - the single sentence worth carrying out of this round, and the reason the seating plan above is so cheaply effective: it blocks view too.
pois.physics: 同一个稀薄大气,在三本账里扮演三种角色,这才是火星窗真正难的地方:**保温**上它是红利(外侧无对流旁路,低辐射率镀膜杠杆 14 倍);**热应力**上它无所谓(内侧舱气占散热七成,两颗星球一样);**失压**上它是杀手(外面就是 600 Pa,没有任何缓冲)。串联的环节放大环境差异,并联的环节稀释它——判断一个火星设计哪里会被环境改写,先看这条通道是串是并。
pois.physics_en: One thin atmosphere plays three different roles across three ledgers, and that is what makes a Martian window hard: for **insulation** it is a dividend (no convective bypass outside, so the low-e coating gets 14x the leverage); for **thermal stress** it is irrelevant (the cabin side carries seven tenths of the heat, identically on both planets); for **depressurisation** it is the killer (600 Pa on the other side, with no buffer at all). Series elements amplify an environmental difference, parallel elements dilute it - to know where a Martian design will be rewritten, first ask whether the path in question is in series or in parallel.

pois.label: 在线镀膜段(火星把一层膜变成了主力保温)
pois.label_en: On-line coater (where a coating outperforms a second pane)
pois.detail: 锡浴出口罩着一台在线热解镀膜机:玻璃带还有 600 °C 时,锡与氟的前驱体在表面分解,长出 300 nm 的 SnO2:F 硬膜——罩下那片泛蓝的板就是镀过的。这在地球是个可选项(省电 4%),在火星是主力手段(省电 51%),原因不在膜而在**大气**:600 Pa 的火星外表面几乎没有对流,窗户的热量七成靠辐射离开,把辐射率从 0.9 压到 0.15 就等于把主路堵死。前驱体的锡就取自隔壁那 3.7 t 锡浴,一火星年只要 37 g。
pois.detail_en: At the tin bath's exit sits an on-line pyrolytic coater: while the ribbon is still near 600 C, tin and fluorine precursors decompose on its surface and grow a 300 nm hard coat of fluorine-doped tin oxide - the bluish pane under the hood has been through it. On Earth this is an option worth 4%; on Mars it is the primary measure, worth 51%. The reason is not the film but the **atmosphere**: at 600 Pa the outdoor surface has almost no convection, so seven tenths of a window's heat leaves by radiation, and dropping emissivity from 0.9 to 0.15 blocks the main road. The tin comes from the 3.7 t bath next door - 37 grams a Mars year.

specs.单层+外镀膜 U: 1.21 —— 比不镀膜的双层中空(1.53)还好
specs.全城节电: 5.4 kW(133 kWh/sol)= 本厂自耗的 0.24 倍
specs.前驱体: 锡取自本厂锡浴;氟源接 ops-fab-01 的 HF 中和支线

specs_en.Coating benefit: 51% on Mars, 3.7% on Earth - a 14x leverage

sim: 第一轮把「一片 12.5 mm 成型」当成纯红利,只算了结构没算热。账 10 把热补上:⌀3.1 m 端窗单层裸窗 U=2.44,热损 1530 W = **37.7 kWh/sol**——窗是舱体保温最薄的一环。四种做法对照:裸单层 2.44 / **单层+外镀膜 1.21** / 裸双层 1.53 / 双层+腔面镀膜 1.02。**主结论反直觉:单层加一层膜,比不镀膜的双层中空还好,而且省一整片玻璃。**
为什么这在地球不成立:地球外表面有 20 W/m2K 的**对流旁路**,你把辐射压下去热照样从对流走(只省 3.7%);火星 600 Pa 下那条旁路只有 1 W/m2K,压住辐射就等于压住了全部(省 51%)。同一层膜,杠杆差 14 倍。
sol 净账:裸窗白天得热 13.3 − 夜里失热 37.7 = **−24.4 kWh/sol**(窗白天是暖气,夜里是洞);镀膜后 −7.8,把洞收窄 3.1 倍。全城受供暖玻璃面 52.7 m2 算下来,镀膜省 **5.4 kW**——**给全城的窗镀一层膜,省下的电是整座玻璃厂自身耗电的四分之一。本厂最省电的产品不是玻璃,是玻璃表面那 300 nm。**

【第三轮:镀膜镀在哪一面,被另外两本账定死了(账 12/13)】第二轮的结论是「镀外表面」,因为只有外表面拦得住向天空的辐射。但账 12 说承压窗必须双层,账 13 说火星尘里有 2 种矿物硬于 SnO₂:F 硬膜、外表面早晚要被清洗磨蚀。两条合起来:**承压窗的镀膜一律做在腔面**(U=1.02,受两片玻璃保护,终身不见尘);**外表面镀膜只留给不承压玻璃**(博物馆玻璃前厅那种,U=1.21),而它的镀层寿命就由清洗规程独家决定——所以那处必须配静电幕并严禁干擦。**同一层膜,镀在哪面由『这块玻璃承不承压』决定。**
sim_en: Round one treated 'one 12.5 mm pane' as a pure dividend, having costed the structure but not the heat. Ledger 10 adds the heat: a bare single-glazed 3.1 m end window has U = 2.44 and loses 1530 W, or **37.7 kWh/sol** - the thinnest part of a habitat's insulation. Four options compared: bare single 2.44 / **coated single 1.21** / bare double 1.53 / coated double 1.02. **The headline is counterintuitive: a single pane with one coating beats an uncoated double-glazed unit, and saves a whole sheet of glass.**

Why this fails on Earth: an Earth facade has a 20 W/m2K **convective bypass**, so suppressing radiation just sends the heat the other way (a 3.7% saving). At 600 Pa that bypass is 1 W/m2K, so suppressing radiation suppresses nearly everything (51%). Same film, 14x the leverage.

Per-sol net: a bare window gains 13.3 kWh by day and loses 37.7 by night, netting **-24.4 kWh/sol** - a radiator by day, a hole by night. Coated, that becomes -7.8, narrowing the hole 3.1x. Across the city's 52.7 m2 of heated glazing the coating saves **5.4 kW** - **coat the city's windows and the electricity saved is a quarter of what the entire glassworks consumes. This plant's most power-efficient product is not the glass; it is the 300 nm on its surface.**

[Round three: which face gets coated was decided by two other ledgers (ledgers 12 and 13)] Round two concluded 'coat the outer face', since only the outer face intercepts the radiative path to the sky. But ledger 12 requires pressure windows to be double, and ledger 13 finds two minerals in Martian dust harder than the SnO2:F film, so an exposed face will eventually be abraded by cleaning. Together: **pressure windows always take the coating on the cavity face** (U = 1.02, protected by both panes, never exposed to dust), while **outer-face coating is reserved for non-pressure glazing** such as the museum foyer (U = 1.21), whose coating life then depends entirely on the cleaning regime - which is why that installation needs an electrostatic curtain and an absolute ban on dry wiping. **Same film; which face it goes on is decided by whether the pane holds pressure.**
pois.physics: 热解硬镀层与磁控软镀层的分工决定了这份红利归谁:软镀层怕磨,只能躲在中空玻璃的腔面里,那是地球的做法;热解硬镀层与玻璃同炉长成,耐磨耐尘,**敢镀在朝外的那一面**——而只有朝外那一面才拦得住向天空辐射的那条主路。火星的稀薄大气把「辐射」从配角变成主角,于是一层原本用来省钱的膜,在这里变成了保温的主力。
pois.physics_en: The division between pyrolytic hard coats and sputtered soft coats decides who gets this dividend. Soft coats cannot take abrasion, so they hide on the cavity face of a sealed unit - Earth's practice. A pyrolytic coat grows with the glass, survives dust and handling, and can therefore go on the **outward** face - and only the outward face intercepts the radiative path to the sky. Mars's thin atmosphere promotes radiation from bit player to lead, and a film that merely saved money on Earth becomes the main insulation here.

pois.label: 退火窑排(哪些工艺火星不打折)
pois.label_en: Annealing lehrs (what Mars does not discount)
pois.detail: 两条退火隧道:一条给铸石析晶,一条给浮法板消应力。玻璃退火是让内应力在粘性流动中松弛,再慢冷锁住低应力状态——松弛时标 τ=η/G,粘度与剪切模量都是原子尺度性质,重力不在式子里。所以这两条窑的时间-温度曲线原样照抄地球,一个参数都不用改。这块卡与娱乐中心台球桌那张『碰撞不变』是同一族:火星改写的是重力过程,不是物质本身。
pois.detail_en: Two annealing tunnels: one crystallises cast stone, one de-stresses float sheet. Annealing lets internal stress relax through viscous flow, then locks the low-stress state in by slow cooling. The relaxation time is tau = eta/G, and both viscosity and shear modulus are atomic-scale properties - gravity is not in the equation. So both lehrs run time-temperature curves copied from Earth without changing a single number. This card belongs to the same family as the rec-centre billiards card, 'collisions unchanged': Mars rewrites gravity processes, not matter itself.

specs_en.Annealing point: eta = 1e12 Pa.s, tau = eta/G about 33 s
specs_en.Crystallisation lehr: 8.4 m with an 800-900 C soak section
specs_en.Schedule: identical to Earth, point for point (ledger 5)

pois.sim: 『重力打折表』(账 5,全册对照卡):不打折——退火/应力松弛、化学动力学与酸浸、电解(FFC 同句)、切削力(铸造厂同句)、台球碰撞(娱乐中心同句)。打折——澄清排泡 ×2.64(Stokes ∝ g)、熔池自然对流 ×0.38(Ra ∝ g,搅拌补)、浮法自然厚度 ×1.63(账 3)。旁注:物理钢化靠风栅对流淬冷,50 kPa 车间气下换热打 7 折——温室薄板改用化学钢化(离子交换,不打折)绕开。
pois.sim_en: The gravity-discount table (ledger 5, this volume's cross-reference card). Not discounted: annealing and stress relaxation, chemical kinetics and leaching, electrolysis (FFC's line), cutting forces (the foundry's line), billiard collisions (the rec centre's line). Discounted: fining 2.64x slower (Stokes goes with g), bath convection 0.38x (Ra goes with g, stirrers make it up), float natural thickness 1.63x (ledger 3). Margin note: physical tempering quenches by convective air grids, and at 50 kPa shop gas the heat transfer drops to 0.7x - thin greenhouse sheet switches to chemical tempering (ion exchange, undiscounted) and sidesteps it.
pois.physics: 判据只有一条:公式里有没有 g。扩散、粘性、反应速率、电荷计量——这些由温度与化学势驱动的过程,搬到任何行星都不变;沉降、对流、静压、摆动周期——凡 g 出场的都要重算。把设备清单按这条判据分两栏,火星工厂的设计工作量就先砍掉了一半。
pois.physics_en: There is only one criterion: does g appear in the equation. Diffusion, viscosity, reaction rates, charge stoichiometry - processes driven by temperature and chemical potential carry to any planet unchanged. Settling, convection, static head, pendulum periods - anything where g takes the stage must be redone. Sort the equipment list into those two columns and half the design work of a Martian factory is already finished.

pois.label: 成品架与原料分账(三家不抢一堆矿)
pois.label_en: Product racks and the feed ledger (three plants, no ore fight)
pois.detail: 四个分区把两条产线的结论摆在架上:黑色铸石板一垛、透明与镀膜窗玻璃一垛(泛蓝的是镀过的)、金褐色纤维卷一架,外加托架上那片 ⌀3.1 m 球冠端窗成品——**全册的招牌就立在那里**:火星浮法的自然厚度 11.2 mm 恰好覆盖舱窗需要的 10~12.5 mm,一片成型,不拉不叠。旁边还立着一件双层中空样件,但账 10 之后它主要用于展示对照:单层加一层镀膜比它更省。
pois.detail_en: Four bays put both lines' conclusions on the shelf: a stack of black cast stone, a rack of clear and coated window glass (the bluish ones are coated), a shelf of golden-brown fiber spools, and on the ring stand the finished 3.1 m spherical end window - **the flagship of this whole volume stands right there**: Martian float glass's natural thickness of 11.2 mm covers the 10-12.5 mm a cabin window needs, formed in one pane, neither attenuated nor laminated. A double-glazed sample stands beside it, but after ledger 10 it is mostly kept for contrast: a single coated pane beats it.

sim: 消纳表逐项有主(账 1/6/11):硫基体筋 6.1 kg/sol → ops-printer-01 室外构件;短切纤维增韧 ~3 → 需重熔维修的构件;缠绕带 3 → 管网维修;织物滤布 → 全城;岩棉 18 → 管网/低温/舱体保温**以及本厂自己的窑墙冷侧**;铸石 45 → 矿场/硫厂/铸造厂磨蚀衬板,75 → 地坪台面;窗玻璃 → 村舍球冠端窗、博物馆玻璃前厅、仪器视窗。
**第二轮把最大的客户找出来了**:hab-museum-01 的玻璃前厅 80.7 m² = 2.26 t,占全城装机的 56%——一栋建筑就是本厂一场 72 sol 的战役。该册 berm 卡已写明「前厅玻璃产自本城」,这条链两头现在对上了。
反向核对照旧:res-dome-01 的 ⌀26 m 穹顶仍是 ETFE(玻璃比膜重两个数量级),本厂**不供**大穹顶——这一条如实留在消纳表的『不供』栏里,连同光学级、铅玻璃、Zerodur 与超薄玻璃四类。

【第三轮:碎玻璃有方向,回收是为了少运纯碱(账 15)】成品率 0.78 意味着 22% 是边料——前两轮用了这个数,却从没问过这 22% 去哪。回炉 217 kg/火星年 的边料,省下的电可以忽略(透明线只占全厂 1%),**省下的是进口**:纯碱是唯一永久进口的配料,不回炉就要多进口 28%。**在火星,回收玻璃不是为了省电,是为了少从地球运纯碱。**而且回收有**方向性**:透明边料严格分拣后可回透明线(唯一可逆的一条),一旦混入铁污染或黑玻璃碎片就只能降级去铸石/岩棉,黑线碎料永远回不来。场上那两堆碎玻璃(青灰/黑)之间的隔板就是这条规矩——建议 res-recycle-01 的四色分选加第五色,混一次的代价是把一批稀缺纯碱永久变成铺地砖。
sim_en: Every row of the offtake table has an owner (ledgers 1, 6, 11): 6.1 kg/sol of sulfur-matrix bar to ops-printer-01's outdoor members; about 3 of chopped fiber for members meant to be remelt-repaired; 3 of winding tape for pipeline repair; textile and filter cloth city-wide; 18 of rock wool for pipe, cryo and hull insulation **and for the cold side of this plant's own furnace wall**; 45 of cast stone for abrasion liners at the mine, sulfur plant and foundry, 75 for floors and benches; window glass for village spherical end windows, the museum's glazed foyer, and instrument viewports.

**Round two found the biggest customer**: hab-museum-01's glazed foyer is 80.7 m2 and 2.26 t - 56% of everything installed in the city, so one building is a 72-sol campaign here. That volume's berm card already states the foyer glass is city-made; both ends of the chain now agree.

The reverse check stands: res-dome-01's 26 m dome stays ETFE, since glass is two orders of magnitude heavier than membrane, so this plant does **not** supply the big dome - recorded honestly in the 'not supplied' column alongside optical grade, leaded glass, Zerodur-class ceramic and ultra-thin sheet.

[Round three: cullet has a direction, and recycling is about shipping less soda (ledger 15)] A 0.78 yield means 22% is trim - a number both earlier rounds used without ever asking where it went. Returning 217 kg a Mars year of trim saves negligible electricity, since the clear line is 1% of the plant, but it **saves imports**: soda ash is the only permanently imported ingredient, and without cullet return the city would ship 28% more of it. **On Mars, recycling glass is not about saving power; it is about shipping less soda from Earth.** Recycling is also **directional**: clear trim, strictly sorted, returns to the clear line - the only reversible path - while anything contaminated with iron or black cullet can only be downgraded into cast stone or wool, and black cullet never comes back. The divider between the two cullet piles on the pad (pale grey and black) is that rule made physical - and res-recycle-01's four-way sorting is asked to add a fifth stream, since mixing them once turns a batch of scarce soda permanently into floor tile.
pois.physics: 分账的物理依据是品位与相:磁选尾料低铁,纤维要;原矿高铁,铸石要;水成硅层高硅,窗户要。矿物学早就把三条产线的原料分好了,矿场只需要认得出它们——选采比分选便宜,分选比提纯便宜,这条永远成立的不等式就是整座工业区的组织原则。
pois.physics_en: The physics behind the split ledger is grade and phase: the magsep reject is low in iron, which fiber wants; raw ore is high in iron, which cast stone wants; the water-laid silica horizon is high in silica, which windows want. Mineralogy sorted the three feeds long ago - the mine only has to recognise them. Selective mining is cheaper than separation, separation cheaper than purification: that standing inequality is the organising principle of the whole industrial quadrant.

pois.detail: 控制间背面的大屏滚动全厂能量账。玻璃厂的负荷分三层:黑线熔池群 24 小时连转;透明线一年只开两个战役窗口;辅机跟着日班走。最要紧的一行是基荷:熔池一旦冻结,耐火衬热震开裂、漏板上的玻璃凝死要重铂——『冻结即报废』与硫厂回转窑同款,所以 4.2 kWe 常挂聚变基荷,任何减载阶梯都排不到它。
pois.detail_en: The big screen on the control room's back wall scrolls the plant's power ledger. Load comes in three layers: the black-line melters run 24 hours; the clear line opens only two campaign windows a year; auxiliaries follow the day shift. The line that matters most is baseload: if a melt pool freezes, the refractory cracks in thermal shock and the glass frozen on the bushing means re-platinising - 'freeze equals write-off', same clause as the sulfur plant's rotary kiln. So 4.2 kWe hangs permanently on fusion baseload, below the reach of any load-shedding ladder.

sim: 【第二轮把第一轮的账翻了一倍】自下而上重算(账 8):熔窑+前炉共壳壁损 11.75 + 熔化焓 3.24 + 漏板 0.45 + 析晶窑 3.67 + 岩棉线 1.5 + 辅机 1.5 + 透明线稳态占空 0.21 = **22.3 kWe / 551 kWh/sol**,是第一轮 12.4 的 1.80 倍;基荷 4.2 → **13.7 kWe**。错的不是方法是输入:第一轮的壁损 1.6 kW 是拍的,真实值 11.75 kW。
一根纤维的三个电价,取决于你问的是哪个问题(res-sulfur-01『看你怎么记账』同族):**专用炉口径 4.99** kWh/kg(若纤维自带一座炉——地球 CBF 工业带 4~6 回答的正是这个问题);**共用炉分摊 3.79**(本厂的账怎么摊);**边际 0.78**(炉子反正热着,多拉一公斤要多少电)。三个数都对,答的是三个问题。
余热『算了再说』的结果不变:可捕集 6 kWt,输到 300 m 外的温室排要损 75% 在管路上——不值得建管。厂内梯级(配合料预热 + 退火窑逆流)吃掉一半,其余就地辐射。
厂房**不增压**(账 8):把 672 m³ 车间充到 70 kPa 一次要 2951 kWh = 全厂 9.6 个 sol 的电,还要一整栋压力壳。主厂房因此是防尘棚(场上那座敞开钢棚就是它),全厂唯一的增压体积是控制间与它旁边那只气闸。白拿三件事:600 Pa 本身是粗真空;无氧大气里 5% H₂ 保护气**不可燃**——地球浮法线最大的安全项在火星消失;外表面几无对流,窑的保温白赚。
sim_en: [Round two doubled round one's ledger] Rebuilt bottom-up (ledger 8): 11.75 kW of wall loss from the shared melter-forehearth enclosure + 3.24 melting enthalpy + 0.45 bushing + 3.67 crystallisation kiln + 1.5 wool line + 1.5 auxiliaries + 0.21 clear line at steady duty = **22.3 kWe, 551 kWh/sol**, 1.80x the first pass's 12.4; baseload 4.2 to **13.7 kWe**. The method was not wrong, the input was: round one's 1.6 kW wall loss was asserted, and the real figure is 11.75 kW.

One strand of fiber has three electricity prices, depending which question is asked (the sulfur plant's 'it depends how you keep the books', again): **dedicated-furnace 4.99** kWh/kg (if fiber carried its own furnace - which is exactly what Earth's 4-6 CBF band answers); **shared-furnace 3.79** (how this plant's books allocate); **marginal 0.78** (the furnace is hot anyway; what does one more kilogram cost). All three are correct answers to three different questions.

The waste-heat verdict is unchanged: 6 kWt capturable, 75% lost piping it 300 m to the greenhouse row - not worth the pipe. In-plant cascading (batch preheat, lehr counterflow) uses half; the rest radiates locally.

The hall is **not pressurised** (ledger 8): filling 672 m3 to 70 kPa costs 2951 kWh once - 9.6 sol of the whole plant's power - plus a pressure shell for the building. So the main hall is a dust canopy (that open steel structure on the pad), and the only pressurised volume is the control room and the airlock beside it. Three things come free: 600 Pa is already a rough vacuum; in an oxygen-free atmosphere the 5% hydrogen cover gas **cannot burn**, so the biggest safety item on an Earth float line simply disappears; and with almost no external convection, the furnace's insulation works better.
pois.physics: 熔窑的基荷逻辑与化工窑相同:热质量大、工作温度高的设备,停机成本不是电费而是设备本身。城市电网把这类负荷单列成『不许停』层,是把物理约束翻译成调度语言——玻璃厂在那一层里的 4.2 kWe,排在硫厂的窑与铸造厂的 FFC 槽旁边。
pois.physics_en: A melter's baseload logic is the chemical kiln's: for high-thermal-mass, high-temperature equipment the cost of stopping is not electricity but the equipment itself. The city grid's 'never-stop' tier translates that physics into dispatch language - and this plant's 4.2 kWe sits in it, right beside the sulfur plant's kiln and the foundry's FFC cells.
